definitions.gloss: to summon, to call over, to send for
definitions.explanation: To have someone come to where you are by calling or requesting them. Implies the person summoned travels to the speaker's location.

examples.japanese: ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる。
⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せた。
examples.english: I sent for my mother from the countryside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せて⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: We summoned an expert from overseas and listened to their opinion.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる (send for one's family)
- ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる (summon a doctor)
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる (call people over)

USAGE:
Implies that the person or thing summoned travels a distance to come to the speaker's location. It is commonly used when bringing family members to live with you (e.g., from a rural hometown to the city, or from another country). The directional nuance of ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to draw near) distinguishes this from simply ⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧ (to call) — {呼|よ}び{寄|よ}せる emphasizes the person actually coming to you.
